review_evidence: README identifies HOLMS as a HOL Light library for modal systems with formal soundness/completeness, Kripke semantics, decidability and countermodel construction for K/D/T/K4/S4/B/S5/GL/Grz.
Representative modal.ml and gl_completeness.ml contain extensive `new_definition`, inductive syntax/semantics, proves and completeness theorems.

make.ml is the library load/navigation surface and tests.ml contains mathematically meaningful modal formulas, provability principles and countermodel examples; both are retained rather than path-name filtered.
summary: Reviewed HOLMS and retained all 40 primary files; this is a substantive modal-logic formalization including meaningful test/example formulas and a navigation loader.
